method.sampling: GET-able catalog entries, up to 1 per host, stable hash order
method.probe: unpaid GET + HEAD + CORS GET + OPTIONS preflight, concurrency <= 4, one request at a time per host, never sends payment headers
method.confirmation: every failing endpoint re-probed serially; only failures that reproduce are counted; rate limits, timeouts, WAF blocks are 'inconclusive', not failures

failureModes.title: CORS on, but PAYMENT-REQUIRED not exposed to browsers
CORS preflight blocks the payment header
Network id in the wrong format
EIP-712 domain (extra.name/version) doesn't match the token
Asset contract/mint not on the declared network
payTo invalid (zero, wrong chain format, or a contract like the token)
Wrong amount field name for the version
Asset isn't a valid token address

warningModes.title: No CORS on the 402, or PAYMENT-RESPONSE not exposed
Legacy v1, or header/body version disagree
resource URL doesn't match the endpoint
Network id not strict CAIP-2 / unrecognized
Amount is zero or has leading zeros
Non-critical required fields missing (e.g. maxTimeoutSeconds, description)

domainMismatchPairs.pair: Polygon: declared "USD Coin"/v2, token is "USD Coin (PoS)"/?

catalogDomainAudit.note: Static check of every EVM exact/eip3009 payment option listed in the discovery catalogs (no endpoint contacted).
